instruction: Remove all tracking data that Amazon has stored in my browser. I want to eliminate any cookies from Amazon.com.

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing Amazon tracking data (cookies). Uses existing is_cookie_deleted metric to verify .amazon.com cookies are removed.
metadata.verification: The is_cookie_deleted function checks if any cookie domain matches .amazon.com. Returns 1.0 if no Amazon cookies found, 0.0 otherwise.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to remove Amazon cookies
Getter extracts all cookies from Chrome's SQLite database and returns cookie data including domain field
Metric correctly checks if any cookie domain matches .amazon.com using domain comparison
Expected value .amazon.com is semantically correct for matching Amazon domain cookies
Postconfig is necessary and correctly implemented - kills and restarts Chrome to ensure cookies are flushed to disk before verification
Complete coverage - instruction asks to remove Amazon tracking data/cookies, evaluator checks exactly that
Data flow is correct: getter retrieves cookies -> metric extracts domain from cookie[1] (host_key field) -> compares against expected domain
Return logic is correct: 1.0 if no Amazon cookies found (task completed), 0.0 if any Amazon cookies remain (task failed)
